title: MNX Launches AI Exchange for OpenAI and Anthropic Futures
summary:
Speculators can now bet on the worth of unlisted artificial intelligence firms through a new trading platform. MNX has debuted an exchange that offers futures contracts for OpenAI and Anthropic, enabling market participants to take long or short positions on the valuations of these private labs without holding actual equity.

Winning positions on the platform may receive less than their full payout if collateral and fees are insufficient. The service, developed by a team including Alex Masmej and MNX, went live on October 13 to allow direct trading on the growth of private AI companies.
